findings.defect_1_csv_header: dmsClaimRegistryExport.ts used 'Код услуги' instead of 'Код услуги (804н)' violating test assertions and Order 804n compliance. Fixed.
findings.defect_2_missing_backend_registry: No backend route existed to aggregate statutory DMS claim registries across patients, visits, treatments, and guarantee letters. Implemented GET /api/insurance/registry with full Zod validation and SQL integration.
findings.defect_3_frontend_mock_isolation: DmsRegistryExportModal.tsx previously used static mock data and hardcoded August 2026 strings. Rewired to live Fastify backend, dynamic month names, active clinic profile, and added statutory XML export.
findings.defect_4_modal_unconnected_context: PatientWorkspaceModals.tsx mounted DmsRegistryExportModal without patientId/patientName. Passed patient context to enable scoped registry export.
findings.defect_5_statutory_signature_title: A4 consolidated registry required statutory title 'Руководитель медицинской организации' matching Order 804n and Russian medical executive regulations.
findings.defect_6_cashier_dms_tender_orphan: FiscalPaymentTenderSection.tsx destructured setInsuranceAmount but had no row for Insurance in split payment mode, no 100% DMS preset, and no way for cashier to input guarantee letter number. Fixed.
findings.defect_7_missing_1click_fallback: Under Mandate 8e/8n, if an insurer rejects a claim or limit is exhausted, the cashier needs an instant 1-click fallback to shift insurance coverage to patient card/cash. Added 'Перевести на пациента' button with exact kopeck transfer.
findings.defect_8_patient_card_dms_orphan: PatientCardModal.tsx and PatientGeneralInfoTab.tsx had inputs for DMS policy and company, but no way to open guarantee letters or create a letter. Added 'Гарантийные письма' button, lazy-loaded DmsGuaranteeLetterModal, and API persistence.
findings.defect_9_calculator_unconditional_mocks: DmsBillSplitCalculatorSection.tsx defaulted to DEMO_VISIT_BILL_ITEMS unconditionally, displaying fake services in empty visits. Guarded behind isDemoShowcaseMode() and added authentic empty state.
